IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Saturday, August 15, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is running hot—56 calls with 315 hands needed and every single call lists a rate. Four separate Inglett & Stubbs calls alone are **$40/hr** on QTS and DataBank data center work plus Wellstar Paulding Hospital. Whitehead Electric's hanging cable tray job on DC3 Fayetteville also sits at **$40/hr**. The schedule mix is tight: 4-10s with optional Saturdays, early 6:30am starts. This board is moving fast and steady.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is the per diem play. Parsons Electric's dual Polaris Forge Data Center calls—43 and 34 hands respectively—lock in **$44.80/hr** with **$100/day non-taxed per diem** and a 100+ mile radius. That's 6-10s, ND license required, drug screen. Hunt Electric's Grand Forks Air Base slot adds another **$100/day incentive** on top with valid Real ID, running 4-10s plus Friday OT. Strong money for the Upper Midwest.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** shows 38 calls at 189 hands. Cupertino, Pieper, and MJ Electric all staffing Port Washington Data Center roles—the big pull here is **JW wage plus $10/hr** bump on 50-60 hour weeks, drug test mandatory. Long hours but real premium.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** features Industrial Electric's 12-hand Eli Lilly K153 new construction at **$54.75/hr**, 6-10s Monday-Saturday with extensive background check. Ermco's Lilly LP1 and Malarchy Shingles Factory gigs round out solid pharmaceutical and manufacturing work.

**LU-683 Columbus, OH** has McGraw Kokosing and ESI both staffing Cologix Data Center at **$46/hr**, 5-10s plus Saturday, **all OT paid at double rate**. TSG's ECX Ashville call adds capacity at same scale.

Data center build-out is absorbing the available hands—Midwest and Southeast are where the work's consolidating hard.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Saturday, August 15, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running a massive board—46 calls, 140 hands needed—and NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is the workhorse, hiring 40 JW for Columbus distribution work at 6-10s with $125 nightly PD and $125 bonuses on 10-hour days (CDL required). Another 9 JW spots open for Southern Ohio distro on 4-10s with optional weekend days. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS wants 6 JW for Johnstown cable splicing work at $100/day PD, OSHA 10 card mandatory.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 24 calls hunting 130 hands. Parsons Electric is the anchor—77 Inside JW total across two calls for the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood at **$44.80/hr**, $100/day non-taxed PD, plus Monday-Friday incentive pay at $100/day. Hunt Electric adds 10 more Inside JW at the same rate for Grand Forks Air Base on 4-10s with 8 hours Friday OT.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** shows serious metal: 9 calls, 83 hands. Summit Line is $55/hr base (inside JW) for Project Miner in Santa Teresa, New Mexico, with $1121/week PD for those 350+ miles out. Mass Electric offers the same $55 rate on the same project, 6-10s with all OT double time. Rosendin's Meta El Paso job sits at **$40/hr** with $15 incentive overscale for 90% of 60 hours weekly.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** runs 26 calls (91 hands). SERVICE ELECTRIC has 17 JW on Social Circle GA Power energize work at **$46.80/hr**, plus another 10 JW at the premium **$51.80/hr** rate requiring Quanta Barehand Cert. Both offer $150/day PD. INCEPTION ENERGY adds 9 JW statewide out of Savannah at $46.80, grid experience required.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** is smaller but hot: JW Didado's transmission rebuild in Old Feild, WV shows **$126/hr** at the top end—that's transmission rates talking—with $150/day PD and OP A requirements. C3M's Purple Line work near College Park runs **$55.20/hr** with $100 PD and CDL needed.

Data-center work is the market driver right now—Polaris Forge, Meta, and the Virginia/Maryland transmission stack are pulling hands across three time zones.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Saturday, August 15, 2026**

**LU-213 St. John, NB** is running the biggest board of the week—14 calls for 141 hands chasing Irving Oil Refinery work. Stuart Olson and Lorneville are both feeding the shutdown: 44 journeyman pipefitters on days with Stuart, 39 more on 6x10s with Lorneville, plus 11 apprentices on nights and 10 other hands on a minor outage. This is bread-and-butter refinery tempo—steady, long hours, no mystery. Book depth is thin relative to the call count; if you're current and can move fast, St. John's got runway.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is holding steady at 18 calls and 61 hands across two major contractors. BCS Mechanical is the workhorse: 15 journeyman pipefitters and 13 plumbers on the Sego Project (West Valley), all pulling 4-10s with OT built in starting August 3. DSI's QTS job in Eagle Mountain is running a different rhythm—5-8s and 5-10s mixed, one **$10.00** call for a specialized pipefitter crew of 6. Not premium scale, but solid, consistent hours in a region with no shutdown chaos.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is thick with specialty work: 21 calls, only 30 hands. Charter Mechanical wants 4 orbital welders for Intel tooling at Ronler Acres; Apollo and Harder are looking for BIM detailers and refrigeration techs. This board rewards certification and skill stack over raw labor—tighter, higher-touch projects across semiconductor and commercial systems.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is pumping fabrication and outage work: 9 calls, 32 hands. Graham, Gem, Nooter and Ineos are rotating combo welders and pipefitters through fab shops and maintenance cycles, with **$53.00** marking one call's rate. Incentive pay and fab-shop experience move the needle here. Heavy testing requirement—show your credentials.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** and **LU-325 Fredericton, NB** are slim but solid: Air Force base work in South Dakota (Box Elder, Sturgis) and Irving Oil refinery jobs in New Brunswick respectively, both at **$100/day per diem**. Specialization required; background checks and OSHA 10 non-negotiable.

Refinery shutdowns and semiconductor build-outs are pulling labor east and west simultaneously—the spread is geographic, not cyclical.
